description: This header defines utilities, classes, and functions for WebSocket testing within the Chromium project, including mock socket factories, handshake request/response generators, and test-specific stream helpers.

classes.name: WebSocketMockClientSocketFactoryMaker
classes.description: A helper class to create and manage mock client socket factories for WebSocket tests.

classes.name: WebSocketTestURLRequestContextHost
classes.description: Encapsulates creation of a URLRequestContext with mock socket data for testing WebSocket connections.

classes.name: DummyConnectDelegate
classes.description: A no-op implementation of WebSocketStream::ConnectDelegate for testing.

classes.name: TestWebSocketStreamRequestAPI
classes.description: Test implementation of WebSocketStreamRequestAPI that sets deterministic WebSocket handshake keys.

classes.name: TestWebSocketHandshakeStreamCreateHelper
classes.description: A subclass of WebSocketHandshakeStreamCreateHelper that uses deterministic keys and dummy delegates for testing.

methods.name: WebSocketExtraHeadersToString
methods.description: Converts WebSocketExtraHeaders to a single string.

methods.name: WebSocketStandardRequest
methods.description: Generates a standard WebSocket handshake request string.

methods.name: WebSocketStandardRequestWithCookies
methods.description: Generates a WebSocket handshake request string with cookies.

methods.name: WebSocketStandardResponse
methods.description: Generates a standard WebSocket handshake response string.

methods.name: WebSocketCommonTestHeaders
methods.description: Generates common WebSocket request headers for testing.

methods.name: WebSocketHttp2Request
methods.description: Generates HTTP/2 WebSocket handshake request headers.

methods.name: WebSocketHttp2Response
methods.description: Generates HTTP/2 WebSocket handshake response headers.
